<!-- Vendors welcome. Recipes are held to the same standard regardless of author. -->

## Workload

<AI application | agent workload | model serving | other>

## What it would deploy

One or two sentences: what runs, on what, and the point of it.

## Why it's useful / what gap it fills

<!-- What does someone learn or get that existing recipes don't cover? -->

## Target and prerequisites

Deployment target (and hardware/GPU if relevant), plus the main tools involved.

## Can you provide verification evidence?

- [ ] Yes — I can run it and share results
- [ ] Partially — some parts are untested (I'll mark them)
- [ ] No — this is a request for someone else to build

## Anything already built?

Links to code, a fork, or notes.
